data_fields.name: square_sizes_per_zone_density
data_fields.donor_constant: sizes 1 to 8 exist globally; only sizes with a building for the zone and density may be drawn (donor draws from all)

data_fields.name: footprint_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: size n covers x-i, y+j for i and j below n (down and left of origin)

data_fields.name: rci_catalogue_entries
data_fields.donor_constant: 563 RCI tiles in the data (395 residential, 121 commercial, 40 industrial, 7 agricultural); computed from the JSON, loader not run

best_idea: A powered zone grows by at most five buildings per tick, each the largest square that fits, with the size drawn only from sizes that have a building for that zone and density.
decision_why: The tick, power gate and per-tick cap suit a server zone director, but the donor's size draw, refusals counted toward the cap, row-and-column-only fit test and real-time clock must be fixed first.
acceptance: In a powered zone with free ground, the server adds at most five buildings per server tick, never on an occupied cell, and a fixed-seed server test fails if any attempted size has no catalogue building for that zone and density.
